newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index down on selling of Pudong shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index down on selling of Pudong shares.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares fell around 1.4 percent on Monday dragged down by selling of Pudong development zone related companies and a fall in the domestic currency A share market, brokers said.
Investors unloaded shares of Shanghai's Pudong property developers, including Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co, which helped send the overall market down, they said.
The B index fell 1.089 points or 1.43 percent to 75.280 points on volume of 8.201 million shares worth $3.351 million.

"Profit-taking in Jinqiao emerged in the afternoon, triggering selling in other Pudong property shares, which contributed a lot to the fall in the index," said a broker with a foreign securities firm in Shanghai.
Jinqiao closed down $0.046 or 6.17 percent to $0.700 on volume of 616,500 shares, making it both the second biggest loser and the second most actively traded stock of the day.
The B index was also affected by a sharp fall in the domestic currency A share index during afternoon trading, brokers said.
"B shares fell in the afternoon, dragged down by a sudden fall in the A shares," said an analyst at an Asian securities firm in Shanghai, adding A shares had risen earlier in the day.
Brokers cited a variety of possible reasons for the fall in the A share index, including disappointment in the lack of positive impact from a good interim results announcement.
"But trading volume was still thin, indicating most investors are still taking a wait-and-see attitude," said the broker at the foreign securities firm.
Of 45 B shares, 35 traded with 20 down, nine flat and six up.
Trading firm Shanghai Goods and Materials Co 900927.SS was the worst B share performer on speculative selling, slumping $0.010 or 6.94 percent to $0.134.
Pudong-related share Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co also performed poorly, ending down $0.064 or 5.02 percent to $1.210.
The A index also fell on Monday, led by selling of blue chip shares on poor market sentiment, despite some institutional support earlier on Monday, brokers said.
The A index fell 17.059 points or 1.35 percent to 1,248.554 points on volume of 476.792 million shares worth 5.966 billion yuan.

Tire component maker Shenma Industry Co on Monday reported a 111 percent year-on-year rise in net profit for the first half to 90.58 million yuan, but the news failed to help the A share market end higher, brokers said.
The SSE30 blue chip index closed down 89.061 points or 2.28 percent to 3,815.521 points.
Brokers said the A and B share markets could fall further on Tuesday.
